label: Off by one
description: Differs from the correct answer by 1

label: Carry or borrow
description: Column by column without carrying or borrowing

label: Reversed digits
description: The digits of the answer in reverse order

label: Wrong operation
description: Another operation on the same numbers

label: Unit slip
description: A unit conversion off by a power of ten

label: Implausible
description: More digits than the answer and over twice its size

label: Other
description: None of the rules above match
